owner_note: Flow audio slots outside story scenes (docs/design/FIRST_LAUNCH_FLOW.md). Engineering owns the slot list; the narrative team assigns each value (owner decision D-08). null = silent. Music and sfx values are cue ids (res://assets/audio/music|sfx/<id>.ogg); voice values are <speaker_id>/<line_id>. flow.title is the owner's main theme only if the owner supplies it.
